title: Отцы и дети
author: Иван Тургенев
background: cool pale blue-grey, clearly blue rather than beige
subject: A novel about generational conflict, nihilism and the fragile bond between parents and children in 1860s Russia. Central visual metaphor: two large overlapping forms from different eras, divided by a narrow wedge. Mood: restrained, tense, intellectually severe.

title: Анна Каренина
author: Лев Толстой
background: muted powder pink with a cool undertone
subject: A tragic novel about desire, social judgment, isolation and irreversible choice in 1870s Russia. Central visual metaphor: a pale oval crossed and permanently split by a black diagonal. Mood: elegant, cold, intimate and fatal.

title: Война и мир
author: Лев Толстой
background: pale lavender-grey, clearly violet rather than beige
subject: An epic novel about private life, history, war and the search for meaning during the Napoleonic era. Central visual metaphor: one circle, half built from an orderly grid and half fractured. Mood: monumental yet humane, full of motion and reflection.

title: Преступление и наказание
author: Фёдор Достоевский
background: smoky medium cool grey with a faint blue undertone
subject: A psychological novel about guilt, moral pride, poverty and possible redemption in 1860s Saint Petersburg. Central visual metaphor: a heavy black square with a constricted inner void, cut by a thin arc. Mood: oppressive, feverish and morally charged.

title: Ревизор
author: Николай Гоголь
background: muted mustard yellow, saturated enough to avoid parchment
subject: A satirical play about corruption, fear and collective self-deception in a provincial Russian bureaucracy. Central visual metaphor: a regimented sequence of identical circles invaded by one absurdly rotated empty circle. Mood: comic, anxious and grotesque.

title: Мёртвые души
author: Николай Гоголь
background: dusty terracotta red, earthy but distinctly red
subject: A darkly comic journey through provincial Russia about greed, spiritual emptiness and identities reduced to entries in a ledger. Central visual metaphor: a grid of empty rectangular cells, with black emptiness protruding from one cell. Mood: earthy, absurd and unsettling.

title: Герой нашего времени
author: Михаил Лермонтов
subject: A fragmented psychological portrait of a detached young officer in the Caucasus, exploring boredom, freedom and self-destruction. Central visual metaphor: a solitary tall black vertical at the intersection of two distant diagonal fields. Mood: austere, mountainous and alienated.

title: Капитанская дочка
author: Александр Пушкин
subject: A historical novel about honor, loyalty and love during the Pugachev rebellion in 1770s Russia. Central visual metaphor: a small pale diamond held between two large opposing wedges. Mood: wintry, courageous and precarious.

title: Евгений Онегин
author: Александр Пушкин
background: muted lilac with a cool grey undertone
subject: A novel in verse about boredom, timing, missed intimacy and social ritual in 1820s Russia. Central visual metaphor: two mismatched forms that almost touch but depart along different axes. Mood: elegant, ironic and quietly regretful.

title: Господин из Сан-Франциско
author: Иван Бунин
subject: A story about wealth, mortality and the indifference hidden beneath luxury in the early twentieth century. Central visual metaphor: a heavy black oval of luxury suspended above a thin collapsing horizon. Mood: polished, cold and ominous.

title: Тёмные аллеи
author: Иван Бунин
subject: Stories about memory, sensual love, separation and encounters that return too late. Central visual metaphor: two dark ribbons briefly crossing before disappearing through opposite edges. Mood: autumnal, intimate and melancholic.

title: Золотой ключик, или Приключения Буратино
author: Алексей Толстой
background: clear muted turquoise, playful and distinctly blue-green
subject: A playful adventure about a lively wooden boy, friendship, theatre and a small key that opens a hidden possibility. Central visual metaphor: a radically simplified golden key assembled from a circle and two rectangles. Mood: mischievous, theatrical and bright.

title: Двенадцать стульев
author: Илья Ильф и Евгений Петров
background: pale mint green, clearly green rather than cream
subject: A satirical chase through 1920s Soviet life in search of jewels hidden inside one chair. Central visual metaphor: a rhythm of twelve identical rectangular modules with one sharply displaced. Mood: brisk, absurd and opportunistic.

title: Три сестры
author: Антон Чехов
subject: A play about three sisters longing for another life while time quietly passes in a provincial town. Central visual metaphor: three elongated ovals at different depths, connected by one thin horizontal. Mood: dusky, suspended and tenderly unresolved.

title: Чайка
author: Антон Чехов
subject: A play about art, ambition, unreturned love and the harm people cause while trying to be seen. Central visual metaphor: a single white wing-shaped cut crossing a heavy black disc. Mood: lakeside, fragile and sharply tragic.

title: Вишнёвый сад
author: Антон Чехов
background: soft cherry-blossom pink, luminous but not white
subject: A play about beauty, debt, social change and a family unable to prevent the loss of its estate. Central visual metaphor: a fragile cluster of pale blossom-circles cut by a rigid vertical. Mood: luminous, nostalgic and already disappearing.

title: Гроза
author: Александр Островский
background: stormy medium blue-grey, clearly blue and dramatic
subject: A drama about confinement, desire, public morality and a young woman's resolve in a nineteenth-century Volga merchant town. Central visual metaphor: a massive broken black wedge tearing through a compressed horizontal grid. Mood: electrically charged, oppressive and defiant.

title: Одиссея
author: Гомер
background: deep aegean sea blue, saturated and clearly blue
subject: An ancient Greek epic about a ten-year homeward voyage, cunning against monstrous odds, endurance at sea and loyalty that outlasts twenty years. Central visual metaphor: a single small archaic oared ship crossing an immense field of wine-dark sea, pulled toward one distant point of home. Mood: ancient, austere, wind-driven and quietly heroic.
